title: How Well Do You REALLY Know Music? 🎵 50 Music Trivia Questions | Music Quiz #15
description_hook: 🎵 From the King of Pop to the Eras Tour: 50 music questions that'll sort the true fans from the shuffle-players.
thumbnail_tagline: Only REAL music fans would know

questions.note: Giulia, 6 and 10 Nov 2026: no approval stops; fully automated. Written and fact-checked by Claude 16 Nov 2026 (weekly run), web-checked where unsure. Medium difficulty trial (Q1-5 easy, hardest Q36-50). Family-friendly; GIF searches avoid real people's faces.

tags_research: Weekly report 16 Nov 2026 (vidIQ): 'music quiz' ~65k searches/month (competition 46), '80s music quiz' ~4.7k, '2000s music quiz' ~4.7k. 'guess the song' left out: not our format. Competitor research (vidIQ outliers, 16 Nov): Michael Jackson quizzes at 1M+ views ('How Well Do You Know Michael Jackson?', WhizQuizz, 48j1845B3Zo, 1.2M; 'Guess 25 Michael Jackson Songs', TIM QUIZ, WCbCp41kqjk, 1.3M), so 5 family-friendly MJ questions are included. vidIQ score_title 90.

questions.question: Which pop star is known around the world as the 'King of Pop'?
questions.reveal: He had 13 solo No. 1 singles on the US Billboard Hot 100.

questions.question: Which instrument has rows of black and white keys?
questions.reveal: A standard modern piano has 88 keys: 52 white and 36 black.

questions.question: How many members were in The Beatles?
questions.reveal: John, Paul, George and Ringo were nicknamed the Fab Four.

questions.question: Elvis Presley is often called 'the King of' what?
questions.reveal: His first US No. 1 was 'Heartbreak Hotel' in 1956.

questions.question: What is Michael Jackson's famous dance move that looks like gliding backwards?
questions.reveal: He first showed it on TV in 1983, on the Motown 25 TV special.

questions.question: Which Swedish group sang 'Dancing Queen' and 'Mamma Mia'?
questions.reveal: Their songs became the hit stage musical Mamma Mia! in 1999.

questions.question: Which singer released 'All I Want for Christmas Is You' in 1994?
questions.reveal: The song climbs back up the charts almost every December.

questions.question: Which British band recorded 'Bohemian Rhapsody'?
questions.reveal: The song is nearly six minutes long and has no chorus.

questions.question: How many strings does a standard guitar have?
questions.reveal: A bass guitar usually has just four strings.

questions.question: What spinning ball, covered in tiny mirrors, hangs above dance floors?
questions.reveal: Mirror balls became the symbol of 1970s disco, but are much older.

questions.question: Which K-pop group got their first US No. 1 with 'Dynamite' in 2020?
questions.reveal: The group has seven members, and their fans are called ARMY.

questions.question: Which singer had huge hits with 'Hello' and 'Rolling in the Deep'?
questions.reveal: 'Hello' was the first song to sell a million US downloads in a week.

questions.question: Which singer-songwriter had hits with 'Perfect' and 'Thinking Out Loud'?
questions.reveal: He often performs alone on stage with a guitar and a loop pedal.

questions.question: What was Victoria Beckham's nickname in the Spice Girls?
questions.reveal: Their first single 'Wannabe' spent seven weeks at No. 1 in the UK.

questions.question: Which singer-songwriter had hits with 'Shake It Off' and 'Love Story'?
questions.reveal: She started out as a teenage country singer in Nashville.

questions.question: Which Michael Jackson album is the best-selling album of all time?
questions.reveal: Released in 1982, it has sold an estimated 70 million copies.

questions.question: Which music award is shaped like a little golden gramophone?
questions.reveal: Its name comes from 'gramophone', an early kind of record player.

questions.question: Which Hawaiian instrument looks like a small guitar with four strings?
questions.reveal: Its name is often translated as 'jumping flea' in Hawaiian.

questions.question: Which singer, who began in Destiny's Child, had a solo hit with 'Crazy in Love'?
questions.reveal: 'Crazy in Love' topped the US chart for eight weeks in 2003.

questions.question: Elton John wrote songs like 'Circle of Life' for which 1994 Disney film?
questions.reveal: His 'Can You Feel the Love Tonight' won the Oscar for Best Original Song.

questions.question: In The Beatles' song, what colour is the submarine?
questions.reveal: Drummer Ringo Starr sang the lead vocal on 'Yellow Submarine' in 1966.

questions.question: What is the name of the singing contest between countries held every year since 1956?
questions.reveal: The very first contest in 1956 had just seven countries taking part.

questions.question: Which singer had hits with 'Material Girl', 'Holiday' and 'Like a Prayer'?
questions.reveal: She is often called the 'Queen of Pop'.

questions.question: Michael Jackson famously wore one sparkly white what on one hand?
questions.reveal: His single rhinestone glove became one of pop's most famous looks.

questions.question: Which Mark Ronson song featuring Bruno Mars spent 14 weeks at No. 1 in the US?
questions.reveal: It won Record of the Year at the 2016 Grammy Awards.

questions.question: What is the name of Elvis Presley's famous home in Memphis?
questions.reveal: It opened to the public as a museum in 1982.

questions.question: Which brass instrument changes its notes with a long sliding tube?
questions.reveal: Its name means 'big trumpet' in Italian.

questions.question: Who was the legendary lead singer of Queen?
questions.reveal: He was born Farrokh Bulsara on the island of Zanzibar in 1946.

questions.question: Which English city did The Beatles come from?
questions.reveal: They played nearly 300 times at the city's Cavern Club.

questions.question: Which Queen anthem is famous for its stomp-stomp-clap beat at sports games?
questions.reveal: Guitarist Brian May wrote it in 1977.

questions.question: At Eurovision, how many points is 'douze points'?
questions.reveal: Twelve points is the top score a country can give one song.

questions.question: With which song did ABBA win Eurovision in 1974?
questions.reveal: In 2005 it was voted the best Eurovision song of the contest's first 50 years.

questions.question: What was Emma Bunton's nickname in the Spice Girls?
questions.reveal: She was the youngest member of the group.

questions.question: Which Beatles album cover shows them walking over a zebra crossing?
questions.reveal: The crossing in London became a protected listed site in 2010.

questions.question: The Beatles' name is a pun on which kind of insect?
questions.reveal: It mixes 'beetles' with 'beat', as in beat music.

questions.question: Michael Jackson first moonwalked on TV in 1983 while singing which of his songs?
questions.reveal: It spent seven weeks at No. 1 in the US in 1983.

questions.question: Which 2012 K-pop song was the first YouTube video to reach one billion views?
questions.reveal: Its horse-riding dance was copied by millions around the world.

questions.question: Which Taylor Swift tour, from 2023 to 2024, was the first ever to earn over $2 billion?
questions.reveal: It ran for 149 shows across five continents.

questions.question: Adele's albums '19', '21', '25' and '30' are named after what?
questions.reveal: '21' was the world's best-selling album of both 2011 and 2012.

questions.question: Ed Sheeran's albums are named after maths symbols. What is the '÷' album called?
questions.reveal: His other albums include + (Plus), × (Multiply) and = (Equals).

questions.question: In 2021, which Ed Sheeran song became the first to reach 3 billion Spotify streams?
questions.reveal: It was the UK's biggest-selling single of 2017.

questions.question: In which year did 'All I Want for Christmas Is You' first reach No. 1 in the US?
questions.reveal: It took 25 years after its 1994 release to get there.

questions.question: Céline Dion won Eurovision in 1988 representing which country?
questions.reveal: She won by just one point, singing in French.

questions.question: Which Dolly Parton song did Whitney Houston turn into a 1992 hit for The Bodyguard?
questions.reveal: Whitney's version spent 14 weeks at No. 1 in the US.

questions.question: Which double-reed woodwind instrument usually plays the note an orchestra tunes to?
questions.reveal: It plays an A, and the rest of the orchestra matches it.

questions.question: Which Pink Floyd album's cover shows a beam of light passing through a prism?
questions.reveal: It spent more than 900 weeks on the US Billboard 200 album chart.

questions.question: On which TV talent show was One Direction formed in 2010?
questions.reveal: They finished third on the show, then became a worldwide hit.

questions.question: What do the four letters in ABBA stand for?
questions.reveal: Agnetha, Björn, Benny and Anni-Frid.

questions.question: What was Mel C's nickname in the Spice Girls?
questions.reveal: She was famous for doing backflips on stage.

questions.question: Which 1967 Beatles album's full title ends with 'Lonely Hearts Club Band'?
questions.reveal: It won the Grammy for Album of the Year in 1968.
